analysis.canvasSummary: 1672x941 corporate annual-results infographic for 智创未来科技有限公司. Dominant palette: white, navy blue, royal blue, cyan, teal, violet, orange, and green. The page contains a top-left logo and company name, large Chinese calligraphy headline, skyline/mountain hero art, KPI cards, a donut chart, strategic-goal cards, roadmap, capability icons, a bar-and-line chart, corporate values, and a dark-blue quotation/footer banner.
analysis.backgroundDescription: White corporate infographic background with very light blue-gray gradients, subtle translucent wave lines, faint mountain silhouettes, and clean panel spacing. Main composition is a large blue hero area on the left, a white analytics dashboard on the right, and three lower information/chart sections.
